resources.string: Neon icons and retro wallpapers for your Android

The icons work with launchers that support icon packs, such as Nova, Lawnchair, Smart Launcher, Niagara and Action Launcher. Tap "Apply icons" and pick your launcher.

The stock Samsung (One UI) launcher and some other stock launchers do not support third-party icon packs. On those phones, install one of the launchers above or just use the wallpapers.

Apps without a dedicated icon get the neon backdrop automatically.
